landing.eyebrow: Built for night markets & multi-branch retail
landing.heroSubtitle: Offline-first POS, printed receipt math down to the centavo, and real-time warehouse-to-store dispatch for Philippine retail.
landing.marqueeItems: Sari-sari stores ✳ Night market stalls ✳ Bakeries ✳ Cafes ✳ Mini-marts ✳ Hardware ✳ Multi-branch warehouses
landing.featuresHeader: Built to survive brownouts, rush hour, and five branches.
landing.featuresSub: Numbered to the centavo, stored locally first, synced whenever signal returns.

features.posBody: Cash, GCash, Maya, Card, or Split Tender with Hold/Resume (F6) and crisp 58mm/80mm printed receipts.
features.warehouseBody: Monitor multiple hubs, pair low-stock branches automatically, and send stock transfers with printable pick lists.
features.utangBody: Track customer credit balances, due dates, overdue alerts, load sales, and e-wallet service fees without guesswork.
features.syncBody: Cashiers never stop selling when Wi-Fi drops. Queued tickets, counts, and shift closes sync cleanly in order.

landing.howTitle: From sign-up to ringing up in three steps.

howSteps.step1Body: Launch a free single store in seconds, or configure multiple stores and central warehouses under one owner.
howSteps.step2Body: Import products via CSV, assign cashier and warehouse roles with Supervisor PINs, and enable warehouse bins where needed.
howSteps.step3Body: Ring sales on browser or Android, dispatch warehouse replenishment in one click, and count down the drawer at shift close.

pricing.title: Start free. Scale stores when you're ready.
pricing.subtitle: Solo Mode is free for single-store counters. Upgrade to Full Mode when you add staff shifts, multiple branches, and warehouses.
pricing.bullet2: Supplier POs, cycle counts, bin put-away & pick lists
pricing.bullet3: Cashier X/Z shifts, Supervisor PIN & audit trail
